subject: [PATCH 2/2] perf/x86/amd/uncore: Free counter slot by index

2026-09-21.patch_summary: This patch optimizes the deletion of events in the AMD uncore PMU by directly using the recorded index instead of scanning for it, reducing the number of compare-exchange operations required. This change improves performance and reduces the load on the system, particularly in scenarios with high event creation/deletion rates such as those encountered in production workloads.
